acceptance.item: P4-RT-07-01: T10 hydrates into a 'pending' orbit that empties output lines the server rendered, so B3 instances shrink by 24 px and grow back, shifting the face table and controls
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T10.spec.ts > regressions > M7: hydration keeps every output line of the server markup while the data files load; and > M7: Cumulative Layout Shift at most 0.1 at the reading positions of b4, b5, b7, b11 and b12
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base: with the data files held after hydration, the outs diff shows source=, sharedEdges=, pointsDrawn= and edgesDrawn= emptied on every M7 root. Cause: the browser starts the configured orbit as 'pending' with its vertices only, while the server renders it complete. Fix: those lines (plus edgeCount and the legend labels of a move-graph figure) are read once from the server markup on hydration, through the $props.id element, and shown until the browser's own values arrive. Green: texts and every box unchanged while held, loaded and drawn. The lens script now gives CLS 0.0000 on islands 4, 6, 12 and 14 (was 0.3002 and 0.3161). The script reproducer became the two tests. Commit 3da77cd.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-07-02: T10 instances with a prediction grow by 150 px (226 px at 320 px) on hydration because Predict.svelte arrives later and replaces a shorter static question
acceptance.test: site/tests/e2e/T10.spec.ts > regressions > M7 b4 and b7 (with a prediction) keep their height when they hydrate, at 360 px / at 320 px
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Red at base: 'b4: height 2219 before hydration, 2369 after' (+150) at 360 px, and 2372 -> 2522 at 320 px. Cause: the static block lacked Predict's answer form and layout. Fix: T10's static block holds Predict.svelte's form with its controls disabled, laid out by a copy of Predict's rules, kept inside the 4 kB inline-CSS limit. Predict.svelte is not edited. Green: both widths pass. Lens script: block 278 -> 278 px at 360 and 354 -> 354 px at 320, CLS 0. Commit d13688b.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-04-04: T10 prints its squared edge lengths from floating-point measurements: from rings of four digits the values are wrong, and edges of one length are listed as several
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T10.test.ts > regressions > A3 with rings (1306, 1306, 1306) ... / A3 with rings (999999, ...) / G2 with rings (999999, 999999); site/tests/e2e/T10.spec.ts > regressions > A3 r=1306.1306.1306: one squared length, 3411272 / A3 r=999999.999999.999999: ...
acceptance.evidence: Severity major. Unit red at base: 3 failed, e.g. ['3411272','3411271.999999','3411272'] and ['1999996000001.7036', ...]. Browser red: data-count 2 and 3. Cause: the lengths were measured on float coordinates. Fix: the integers 2 d_i a_i^2 (2 c^2 under make uniform), computed in SafeInt from the gram diagonal. These equal the oracle's weight_inner values: 3411272, 1999996000002, 5999988000006. Green: unit 3 passed, browser 2 passed. Adoption: the lens's unit test and the 1306 browser case are unchanged. The 999999 browser case asserted the 13-digit text '1999996000002', but SPEC 4.0 Long numbers, cited in the finding's own expected, shows such a value shortened. That case now asserts data-count 1 (kept), the shortened text, title='1999996000002' and the exported number 1999996000002. Commit 683ed09.

acceptance.item: P4-RT-04-01: A j turning angle is read as a float with no bound: the turn is rounded, and an angle of 400 digits gives NaN, which T10 then writes into the address bar and into Copy link as a link that cannot be read
acceptance.test: site/tests/unit/tools/T10.test.ts > regressions > an angle of 2^53 + 1 degrees is shown and written back as 33 degrees ... / an angle of 400 digits gives a link that reads back, never the text NaN; site/tests/e2e/T10.spec.ts > regressions > j=xyz:1,2,3@9007199254740993,0,0 turns the picture by 33 degrees ... / j=xyz:1,2,3@<400 digits>,0,0: the link the tool writes back ... is readable
acceptance.evidence: Severity: original minor, raised to major by the refuter; worked as major. Unit red at base: expected 'xyz:1,2,3@32,0,0' to be '...@33,0,0', and the written link contains '@NaN'. Browser red: '32, 0, 0', and the bar holds @NaN. Cause: parseProjection in site/src/components/draw/projector.ts read the angle with Number(). Fix: a safe angle is kept as read; a longer one is reduced modulo 360 exactly with BigInt. The existing projector.test.ts expectations still hold. Green: unit 2 passed, browser 2 passed. Commit ac0873c.

Commit 99c519d.

handoff: Outside T10's directory this branch changes site/src/components/draw/projector.ts (P4-RT-04-01), site/src/components/tools/t11/model.ts and its two test files (T11's export, P4-RT-04-02), and nojs.spec.ts (the toolReport predicate: a snapshot is a canvas tool's figure, and hidden figures count as none). Expect a possible conflict with the accessibility cluster's edits to nojs.spec.ts. No shared library, ToolFrame or Predict.svelte is edited. T10's static prediction block now copies Predict.svelte's form and layout (P4-RT-07-02), so any change to Predict.svelte's markup or CSS must be mirrored there; the regression test 'M7 b4 and b7 ... keep their height' catches drift. P4-RT-05-01 and P4-RT-05-07 are fixed for T10 only, and the lens should rerun the other tools after the accessibility cluster merges. Proposed fixes not followed: P4-RT-04-01 is not refused in the codec (another cluster's file); long angles are reduced exactly instead, a choice the verifiers accepted. P4-RT-07-02 does not load Predict in T10's chunk, which would break the 90 kB budget of /tools/geometry/. P4-RT-04-04 does not round float measurements for make uniform; every shown length is the exact 2 c^2. For MERGE: links-internal.test.ts and repo-ci-playwright-report.test.ts timed out at 5 s in one full site-unit run under load average 16. Neither file nor its subject changed here, and repo-ci passed when rerun alone.
